'''KeePassXC''' (originally '''KeePassX'''<ref name="project">{{cite web |title=The Project |url=https://keepassxc.org/project/ |date=October 16, 2016 |website=KeePassXC |access-date=January 13, 2020 |archive-date=March 31, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170331115440/https://keepassxc.org/project/ |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Thornton |first=Bob |date=January 6, 2020 |title=KeePassXC 2.5.2 |url=https://www.techadvisor.co.uk/download/security/keepassxc-252-3331430/ |url-status=dead |website=Tech Advisor |access-date=January 13, 2020 |archive-date=January 13, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200113202703/https://www.techadvisor.co.uk/download/security/keepassxc-252-3331430/ }}</ref>) is a [[Free and open-source software|free and open-source]] cross-platform [[password manager]]. It is built using the [[Qt (toolkit)|Qt toolkit]], which allows it to run on [[Linux]], [[Microsoft Windows|Windows]], [[macOS]], and [[Berkeley Software Distribution|BSD]],<ref>{{cite web |title=Download |url=https://keepassxc.org/download/ |website=KeePassXC |access-date=July 18, 2018 |archive-date=March 12, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210312172742/https://keepassxc.org/download/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=OpenPorts.se {{!}} The OpenBSD package collection |url=https://openports.se/security/keepassxc |website=OpenPorts.se |access-date=September 2, 2022 |archive-date=August 14, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200814180639/https://openports.se/security/keepassxc |url-status=usurped }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=FreshPorts -- security/keepassxc: KeePass Cross-platform Community Edition |url=https://www.freshports.org/security/keepassxc/ |website=FreshPorts |access-date=September 2, 2022 |archive-date=June 21, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170621051955/https://www.freshports.org/security/keepassxc/ |url-status=live }}</ref> unlike the original [[KeePass]] software.

KeePassXC uses the KeePass 2.x (.kdbx) password database format natively.<ref>{{cite web |title=Documentation and FAQ |url=https://keepassxc.org/docs/#faq-format |website=KeePassXC |access-date=July 18, 2018 |archive-date=April 1, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210401192027/https://keepassxc.org/docs/#faq-format |url-status=live }}</ref> It can also import (and convert) version 2 and the older KeePass 1 (.kdb) databases. KeePassXC supports having key files and [[YubiKey]] challenge-response for additional security.<ref name="project" />

The [[Electronic Frontier Foundation]] mentions KeePassXC as "easy-to-use [and] robust software".<ref>{{Cite web |title=How to: Use KeePassXC |url=https://ssd.eff.org/module/how-use-keepassxc |access-date=2024-10-10 |website=ssd.eff.org |archive-date=September 18, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240918235154/https://ssd.eff.org/module/how-use-keepassxc |url-status=live }}</ref> A security review of KeePassXC version 2.7.4 was completed in late 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |title=KeePassXC Application Security Review |url=https://molotnikov.de/keepassxc-review |website=molotnikov.de/keepassxc-review |language=en-US |access-date=June 27, 2023 |archive-date=June 27, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230627181012/https://molotnikov.de/keepassxc-review |url-status=live }}</ref>

An accompanying browser extension<ref>{{Citation |title=KeePassXC-Browser |url=https://github.com/keepassxreboot/keepassxc-browser |website=KeePassXC |language=en-US |date=August 31, 2022 |access-date=September 2, 2022 |archive-date=September 2, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220902113502/https://github.com/keepassxreboot/keepassxc-browser |url-status=live }}</ref> is available for [[Firefox]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=KeePassXC-Browser – Get this Extension for Firefox (en-US) |url=https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/keepassxc-browser/ |website=Mozilla |language=en-US |access-date=September 2, 2022 |archive-date=August 31, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170831051509/https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/keepassxc-browser/ |url-status=live }}</ref> [[Tor (network)|Tor Browser]], [[Google Chrome]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=KeePassXC-Browser |url=https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/keepassxc-browser/oboonakemofpalcgghocfoadofidjkkk |access-date=2023-08-06 |website=chrome.google.com |language=en |archive-date=May 29, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180529155751/https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/keepassxc-browser/oboonakemofpalcgghocfoadofidjkkk |url-status=live }}</ref> [[Vivaldi (web browser)|Vivaldi]], [[Microsoft Edge]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=KeePassXC-Browser - Microsoft Edge Addons |url=https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/keepassxcbrowser/pdffhmdngciaglkoonimfcmckehcpafo |access-date=2023-08-06 |website=microsoftedge.microsoft.com |archive-date=January 16, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210116031747/https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/keepassxcbrowser/pdffhmdngciaglkoonimfcmckehcpafo |url-status=live }}</ref> and [[Chromium (web browser)|Chromium]]. Extensions can be linked by enabling browser integration in the desktop application.<ref>{{Cite web |title=KeePassXC: Getting Started Guide |url=https://keepassxc.org/docs/KeePassXC_GettingStarted#_setup_browser_integration |access-date=2023-08-06 |website=keepassxc.org |archive-date=August 6, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230806174046/https://keepassxc.org/docs/KeePassXC_GettingStarted#_setup_browser_integration |url-status=live }}</ref>

KeePassXC uses {{mono|zxcvbn}} to assess [[password strength]] and can search for credential breaches using [[Have I Been Pwned?]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite book |last1=Hutchinson|first1=Adryana|last2=Munyendo|first2=Collins W.|last3=Aviv|first3=Adam J|last4=Mayer|first4=Peter|chapter=An Analysis of Password Managers' Password Checkup Tools |date=2024-05-11|title=Extended Abstracts of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems|series=CHI EA '24|location=New York, NY, USA|publisher=Association for Computing Machinery|pages=1–7|doi=10.1145/3613905.3650741|isbn=979-8-4007-0331-7|doi-access=free}}</ref>
